html:
Grand prince of Kievan Rus' from about 980 to 1015, who made his people Christian. Ukrainians call him Volodymyr; Russians, Ukrainians and Belarusians all claim him as a founder.

A son of Prince Sviatoslav, he ruled Novgorod first. With Scandinavian warriors he took Kyiv and killed his brother Yaropolk. He also took the city of Polotsk and its princess. At first he set up idols of the old Slavic gods, led by Perun the thunder god.

In 987 the Byzantine emperor Basil II faced a revolt and asked for help. Vladimir sent some six thousand warriors, the core of the later Varangian Guard. In return he married Basil's sister Anna, something no foreign ruler had won before, and accepted baptism. In about 988 he had the people of Kyiv baptised in the Dnieper (Baptism of Rus'). Rus' took its faith, church art and writing from Constantinople, which tied it to the Orthodox world for good.

He built churches and forts against the Pechenegs of the steppe. When he died his sons fought over the throne, until Yaroslav the Wise won.
sum: Grand prince of Kievan Rus' from about 980 to 1015, who made his people Christian. Ukrainians call him Volodymyr; Russians, Ukrainians and Belarusians all claim him as a founder.
